title: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund - Monthly Scheme Factsheet

sections.content: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund is an open-ended equity scheme predominantly investing in mid cap stocks. As of October 2026, the Scheme Assets Under Management (AUM) stands at ₹1,01,856.06 Crore. The fund seeks to generate long-term capital appreciation by maintaining an active, well-diversified portfolio of fundamentally sound mid-cap companies. The Net Asset Value (NAV) for Direct Plan - Growth option is ₹213.423.

Total Expense Ratio (TER) for HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Plan is 0.74% per annum. Exit load is 1.00% if redeemed or switched out within 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment. No exit load is charged for redemption after 1 year from unit allotment.

Asset allocation: Equity and equity-related instruments 94.20%, Debt securities and cash equivalents 5.80%. Top 10 holdings include Max Healthcare Institute, Indian Hotels Co, Federal Bank, Bharat Electronics, Apollo Hospitals, Coforge, Astral, Sundram Fasteners, Persistent Systems, and Torrent Power. Portfolio turnover ratio is 14.8% on a trailing 12-month basis.

The benchmark index for the scheme is NIFTY Midcap 150 Total Return Index (TRI). Under SEBI product labeling norms, the scheme is classified as 'Very High Risk' on the 6-tier Riskometer. The fund is managed by Chirag Setalvad, Senior Executive Vice President (Managing the fund since June 2007).
